svg.text: How many eggs does a month of a city worker's pay buy?
Average monthly earnings of employees in urban areas ÷ farm-gate price of one hen egg (60 g) · shared log scale
Data: ILOSTAT EAR_EMTA_SEX_GEO_CUR_NB (urban areas, all education levels, both sexes, USD × World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF); FAOSTAT Producer Prices; World Bank NY.GNP.PCAP.CN
Employees only (no self-employed); one survey per country; Argentina has a single year (2005). Farm-gate prices (retail ≈ 1.5–3× higher).
